scope: Reviewer-signed, evidence-backed per-contributor history receipts and chained verification for Agent Commons review prioritization. No scalar reputation score or authority effect is created.
core_invariant: Contribution history is evidence for review prioritization only. Positive history cannot mint authority, and a known retained latest head prevents selective presentation of an older prefix that omits later rejected, superseded, reverted or invalidated entries.

controls: no scalar reputation score is produced
chain must start at sequence one
disposition counts retain negative and reversing categories
reviewer operational key bound to reviewer credential

risks: smuggle popularity score into signed receipt
controls: at least one evidence digest required

risks: discard bad history by changing identity
controls: a different principal ID cannot continue an existing chain
future cross-identity continuity/witness policy remains a promotion gate

risks: good performance in one capability treated as universal competence
repository history exported as global moral score
invalidated/reverted entry lacks link to earlier evidence
accepted entry falsely claims to supersede another
controls: superseded receipt digests required for superseded/invalidated/reverted dispositions
non-reversing dispositions cannot carry supersedes links
all receipts remain in the history chain

known_nonclaims: A8a does not solve global Sybil resistance.
A8a does not solve reviewer collusion.
A8a does not prove cross-principal identity-reset continuity.
A8a does not produce a scalar trust/reputation score.
A8a does not prove global history completeness or currentness without an expected retained latest head.
A8a does not resolve every supersedes digest to an externally available artifact by itself.
A8a does not grant scopes, merge rights, execution rights or approval exemptions.
A8a does not modify the capability registry or production authority path.
next_gates: bind retained latest history heads to an Agent Commons witness/log rather than caller memory alone
support reviewer credential rotation while preserving historical verification
define multi-reviewer/collusion-resistant review policy without creating a global score
bind work-receipt digests to A10 live verification where a contribution claims executed tests or reproductions
add context-specific review-priority policies that remain advisory and non-authorizing
